tex_content.html:
Let $A\subset {\mathcal U}_x(\tau )$ be a measurable subset of $M_{T-\tau }$. The $\mathcal{L}$-reduced volume of $A$ from $x$ (or the reduced volume for short) is defined to be \[ \widetilde V_x(A) = \int _{A} \tau ^{-\frac{n}{2}}\exp (-l_x(q))dq \] where $dq$ is the volume element of the metric $G(T-\tau )$.
